g.title: crate Library of the DevTools app, so that integration tests can build the app.
crate::app The root of the DevTools app: theme, connection states and session screen.
crate::args The command line arguments of the DevTools app.
crate::connection Finding a target, connecting to it, and the connection state screens.
crate::editor Opens a source location in the user's editor.
crate::fonts The DevTools app's offline font bytes, for the app and its tests.
crate::panels The panel modules of the DevTools app.
crate::panels::elements::details The detail tabs of the Elements panel.
crate::panels::elements::locator The test locator expression of the selected node.
crate::panels::elements::owners The owner tree of the Elements panel.
crate::panels::elements::styles The Styles tab of the Elements panel.
crate::panels::elements::view The element tree and details of the Elements panel.
crate::session The actions of one connected DevTools session.
crate::source Where the DevTools app gets its data: a live agent or fixed answers for tests.
crate::state Every state type of the DevTools app: connection, session and inspected tree.
crate::status_bar The status bar of the DevTools app: target, recording and failures.
crate::toolbar The toolbar of the DevTools app: target, window, pick, record and review.
crate::widgets The shared widgets of the DevTools panels.
crate::widgets::box_model The nested boxes of a node's box model.
crate::widgets::color_input A color input with a text value, HSL sliders and a preview.
crate::widgets::flame The flame chart of recorded turns and frames.
crate::widgets::graph The cause graph of one recorded turn or one `why` dependency list.
crate::widgets::override_row One override row: a checkbox toggles it; the editor edits its value.
crate::widgets::property_row A property row with a name, a value and an editor.
crate::widgets::source_link A link to a source location in the user's editor.
crate::widgets::timeline The timeline of recorded turns and frames, with a drag-to-zoom range.
crate::widgets::virtual_tree The virtualized element tree shared by the panels.
